features.title: Reference integrity and destructive changes
features.summary: How destructive or identity-changing operations treat references to their target: reporting the impact and requiring acknowledgement, staying target-local, and keeping dangling or invalid references as repairable diagnostics.

rules.statement: Before deleting a View, UX Flow or authored Asset, renaming a Variant, or renaming a viewport or theme key, the normal Workbench or MCP operation reports the known affected canonical references and proceeds only after the caller explicitly acknowledges that impact.
Such a change stays atomic within its own resource or domain boundary: UIUX never cascades it, auto-rebinds references or silently rewrites referencing resources.

A reference whose target is gone keeps its original target identity and is reported as a structured invalid or dangling diagnostic until it is explicitly repaired; a Workspace with dangling references is a supported, repairable state.

UIUX preserves invalid authored data for repair and reports it; it never silently drops or rewrites it, and never rebinds a reference heuristically by name, type, selector, tree position, geometry or similarity.

features.body:
## Sources

- Discussion #1 comment 171 (2026-09-30), "Accepted convergence decision — target-local destructive change with explicit impact acknowledgement". https://github.com/DevilTea/uiux/discussions/1#discussioncomment-18676070
- Discussion #10 comment 3 (2026-09-30), "Accepted convergence decision — Workspace-local opaque render-dimension IDs": render-dimension key rename is identity-changing. https://github.com/DevilTea/uiux/discussions/10#discussioncomment-18676515
- Discussion #1 comment 158 (2026-09-29), "Accepted decision group — Review anchor model (A / A / A / A)": missing anchor targets are preserved. https://github.com/DevilTea/uiux/discussions/1#discussioncomment-18657409
- Discussion #6 comment 2 (2026-09-30), "Accepted decision group — Flow execution and graph validity (A / A / A / A)": decision 7: invalid Flow references are preserved. https://github.com/DevilTea/uiux/discussions/6#discussioncomment-18673004

## Implementation gaps

- {{R.ws.references.impact-ack}}: Partly built as of 9a8378a: the Workbench Settings page names what still refers to a viewport or theme key and requires an explicit acknowledgement before renaming or removing it (`app/components/workspace/RegistryKeyModal.vue`, since d72ec3b; `tests/workbench-authoring-pages.test.ts#L101`). Not built: `update_workspace_settings` over MCP or HTTP renames those keys without reference-impact analysis, Variant renames (`update_view_structure`) run without it, and no View, UX Flow or Asset delete operation exists. The `ReferenceImpactAnalyzer` port and the `impact_acknowledgement_required` result exist only in `src/application/services/resource-mutations.ts`, which no production service uses. Tracked in issue #75 (https://github.com/DevilTea/uiux/issues/75).
